name: Dream Center Dallas
head: Dream Center Dallas: what they want, what they hate, how they feel about us
about: The Dream Center Dallas is the outreach arm of Church Eleven32 in Oak Cliff, Dallas. Monthly Adopt-A-Block grocery distribution, Thursday food routes, English classes, a women's store, a 24-7 text hotline. Contact: Kacie Kintz (director) and Robyn. Signed 24 Sept 2026: three-month pilot, one production day, unlimited editing, three Are You Happy collaboration posts. Our lead: Nick, with Atdhe.

rel.note: Signed and paid 24 Sept. Kacie: “Kalindi was AMAZING on Saturday!” (12 Oct). Atdhe asked her for a call on 12 Oct.

nps.note: Atdhe sent the 0 to 10 question on 6 Oct. No reply on record.

ver.note: See the One gala video is at V3, the slideshow at V1 with notes. No V1-to-approve data yet.

read.note: On the See the One video she asked for something that moves people. On the slideshow: more personal and community shots, fewer crowd shots, new footage from the 10 Oct day.

quotes.q: hope in a place people said not to go
This is one of our most powerful moments and should be moving.
Kalindi was AMAZING on Saturday! Love her heart and creativity!

loves: Joy, dignity and hope. Smiling faces, busy spaces, real human connection.
Personal and community shots over crowd shots.
Five series: Dallas Did You Know, Outrageous Generosity, Faces of the Dream Center, Why We're Here, donor-facing content.
hates: Trash, empty boxes, clutter, or any framing that makes the community look bad.
Old archive content when new footage exists.
how_to_cut: Neighbors gave verbal consent on camera, not a signed form. First names only.
About half the neighbors speak Spanish. Subtitles on every line.
First cut from a shoot goes to Kacie for style approval, then batch the rest.

perf.note: Instagram: about 6,000 followers, about 240,000 reel views in the 90 days before 1 Oct (Kacie's own numbers). No post-level data pulled yet.

brand.note: No brand colors or font in Drive yet. Nick has been asked. Type the name on end cards until the logo lands.
